post-apostolic-house-church.shortDescription: Christians gathered on the Lord's day and gave thanks over bread and a cup. A bishop's letters greeted a church household by household, and messengers carried them between the churches.

alexandria-catechetical.shortDescription: Teachers led learners through Scripture, reading for a deeper sense beneath the plain story. Origen wrote that Scripture, like a person, has a body, a soul and a spirit.

syriac-edessa-nisibis.shortDescription: Syriac-speaking Christians sang their teaching in hymns. In Ephrem's hymns a refrain came back after every verse, so a congregation learned the faith by singing it.

desert-monasticism.shortDescription: A young landowner heard one Gospel reading, gave away his land and withdrew into the desert. Others left their villages too, to fight demons and the tempting thoughts that demons whispered.

cappadocian-nicene-pastoral-monastic-tra.shortDescription: One family and its friends argued whether the Son and the Spirit are fully God, as the Father is. At the same time they ran churches and fed the hungry through famine.

imperial-juridical-christianity.shortDescription: Bishops of the newly favored church heard lawsuits and went to councils the emperor paid for. One bishop asked an emperor to repent of a massacre before he stood at the altar again.

hieronymian-ascetic-literary.shortDescription: A circle of women gave up wealth and rank to fast and study Scripture, with Jerome as their teacher. Paula's fortune paid his Hebrew teachers as he turned the Old Testament into Latin.

gallic-monastic-ascetic-christianity.shortDescription: A soldier named Martin asked to leave the army to serve Christ. Seized and made a bishop, he kept living as a monk, and monks after him did the same.

the-reformed-cities-zurich-and-geneva.shortDescription: Two cities rebuilt their churches from Scripture. In one, pastors and lay elders met each week over neighbors' quarrels, absent husbands and missed church.

donatism.shortDescription: A rival church held that a sacrament depends on the purity of the hand that gives it. Anyone who crossed over to it was washed again in baptism.

lutheran-wittenberg-and-its-congregation.shortDescription: Luther and the movement around him taught that the commandments frighten the conscience. Then God's promise comforts the sinner through faith.

latin-pastoral-congregational-christiani.shortDescription: Each congregation gathered around one bishop, who taught them, fed their poor and judged their quarrels. With his people, he decided whom to take back after they gave way in persecution.
